target_customer: Ecommerce sellers, agencies, brands and creators who need short form video and image content without a production crew
problem: Producing consistent, studio quality social video and images is slow and costly. Affogato offers AI generated characters, images and video from a text prompt.
business_model: Consumer and team subscriptions for an AI creative suite, with a Teams plan of up to 25 seats
product_category: Generative AI image and video creation

founders.name: Bhagaban Behera
founders.role: Co-founder (author of the YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he spent years building consumer startups with a marketing focus.

founders.name: Nakul Kelkar
founders.background_notes: YC page says he launched multiple 0 to 1 products to hundreds of thousands of users.

founders.name: Sriharsha
founders.role: Co-founder (first name only on YC launch post)
founders.background_notes: Signed the YC launch post as one of three founders; surname and background not stated.

technical_complexity.rationale: Early product was built around consistent faces and controlled image generation using existing models (Facelock and ControlNet per the launch post); the current product orchestrates 110 plus third party models.

defensibility.rationale: Built on third party models available to everyone, with many similar generative media tools; the site itself says it aggregates models from Google, OpenAI, ByteDance and Kling.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not assessed at the 2021 batch because the generative image products came later; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: At the Summer 2021 batch the company's original product is not documented in sources opened; the launch post for RenderNet is undated (over 2 years old at fetch time), so demand evidence from 2021 is unknown.

branding.domain_note: Moved from rendernet.ai to affogato.ai; rendernet.ai now redirects to affogato.ai.

identity.mascot_or_character: AI influencer characters as product feature
identity.voice_and_tone: punchy, tagline No crew. No set. No shoot.

branding.brand_signature: No crew. No set. No shoot. tagline

rebrands.why: One review site says it repositioned toward short form product ads; date and reason unverified, though CB Insights lists the company as formerly RenderNet

branding.community_and_virality: One Trustpilot reviewer mentions the rebrand and an account ban; no other evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: Product name RenderNet had earlier recognition among AI image users; the later rename to a dessert-word brand is recent and sources are thin.

pivots.from: RenderNet AI image generation with consistent faces and ControlNet
pivots.to: AI studio and video agent for short form ads and social video (Affogato)
pivots.why: YC pages show earlier launches (Video Anyone, Narrator, TrueTouch, Character Labs, RenderNet AI) then a short form video agent; dates not given

outcome_analysis: The company is active with 15 people and claims 2 million creators, having moved through several generative media products under the YC listing before settling on Affogato. Funding is not reliably public, so how much it raised and how efficient growth was cannot be judged from verified sources.
notes: Funding unverified, so no rounds recorded: CB Insights (aggregator, page returned 403) shows 6M over 5 rounds with a 5.5M seed on 2021-11-18; Crunchbase shows a seed with Soma Capital; Signalbase shows a 10M Series A for RenderNet with no date; geo.sig.ai says 3M total; a startupintros item on a 6M seed for Affogata in April 2021 may be a different company. Founders: YC page lists two, the YC launch post names three (BB, Nakul, Sriharsha), so Sriharsha is recorded from the launch post; Nakul's surname Kelkar comes from the YC company page. Founded 2019 per YC. HQ San Francisco per YC, Oakland per CB Insights. Competitors empty: searches found no dated 2021 competitor evidence for the original product. No shutdown or layoffs found.
